title: Audit task-sync custody explicitly and seed reconstructable source membership
outcome: Provide a runnable cold custody audit/checkpoint and canonical bootstrap-membership adapter before enabling ordinary managed delta writes.
acceptance: A named custody-audit CLI/service performs exhaustive retained-artifact validation under the existing project and repository reservations, refuses pending or unexplained effects, and never runs implicitly from open, status or ordinary work.

One additive CustodyCheckpoint transition in the existing exchange ledger retains its exact event ID/body and predecessor before commit, updates canonical checkpoint and rebuildable views atomically, and recovers post-commit acknowledgement without changing historical event bodies or completion meaning.

An explicit incoming or prepared-export seed resolves complete initial-import references or captured canonical/embedded documents, validates exact selected source and profile separately from the local destination baseline, and reconstructs membership through repair without retained Git files.

Behavioral tests prove exact interrupted retry, no-write refusal and rollback, custody-only missing-source refusal, legacy reconciled-source unavailability, source older than local baseline, preserved artifacts and named cold audit detection; capacity limits refuse before effects.

Documentation states B1's cold-scan boundary and pending B2/C ordinary writers; projection inventory and final combined repair/no-write/rollback obligations remain under one final cutover, with no standalone B1 landing or ordinary managed enablement.
